name: oreslang-vscode
description: Syntax highlighting, exact keyword colors, and editor diagnostics for Oreslang.

oreslang.colors.keyword.description: Exact editor color for Oreslang language keywords.

oreslang.colors.runtimeGlobal.description: Exact editor color for Oreslang runtime globals such as recover, defer, throw, and raise.

oreslang.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable built-in lexical and structural diagnostics.

oreslang.compiler.command.description: Optional check-only Oreslang compiler executable. Leave blank to disable external compiler diagnostics.

oreslang.compiler.args.description: Arguments for the external compiler. {file} and {workspaceFolder} are substituted.

oreslang.compiler.runOnSave.description: Run the configured external compiler after saving an Oreslang file.

oreslang.compiler.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for an external compiler check.
